description: Source code for helper functions related to 5G NR configuration, including PUCCH resource interval calculations, PRACH frequency start, PUCCH resource estimation, and PUSCH time domain resource recomputation.

methods.name: find_pucch_inner_prbs
methods.description: Calculates the inner PRB interval not used for PUCCH resources, assuming resources are on both sides of BWP.

methods.name: find_largest_prb_interval_without_pucch
methods.description: Finds the largest PRB interval within a BWP that does not contain PUCCH resources.

methods.name: compute_prach_frequency_start
methods.description: Calculates the starting PRB for PRACH, maintaining guardband from PUCCH.

methods.name: compute_nof_sr_csi_pucch_res
methods.description: Estimates number of PUCCH resources needed for SR and CSI based on periods and max grants.

methods.name: compute_max_nof_pucch_symbols
methods.description: Determines maximum number of PUCCH symbols per slot based on SRS and PUCCH configurations.

methods.name: recompute_pusch_time_domain_resources
methods.description: Recomputes PUSCH time domain resource allocations considering TDD configuration and resource duplication.
